UPDATE feed
           SET last_refresh = COALESCE(?, last_refresh),
               next_poll_at = ?,
               failure_count = ?,
               disabled = ?,
               last_error = ?,
               etag = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE etag END,
               last_modified = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE last_modified END,
               moved_from = CASE WHEN ? IS NOT NULL THEN url ELSE moved_from END,
               url = COALESCE(?, url),
               redirected_to = ?
           WHERE pk = ?
